title: Derived inverse limit inverts normalized strict Koszul quotient augmentations on flat K-flat models
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J, A a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], I an ideal, b a Boolean, r a natural number, and a : Fin r → A with span(range a)=I. Let O_b be the constant or completed coefficient sheaf [def-sfb-constant-completion-coefficient-data], G_a the strict dual Koszul tensor tower on the sections algebraSection(baseMap_b)(a_i), and T_b the strict quotient reduction functor. Suppose α : G_a → T_b is a natural transformation satisfying KoszulQuotientAugmentationLaws [lem-u4-constant-koszul-quotient-augmentation]: it preserves the ordinary-limit unit and vanishes on every tensor summand of nonzero Koszul degree. For every cochain complex P of O_b-modules which is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] and whose terms are flat, the map rlim(O_b)(TQ(O_b)(α_P)) is an isomorphism in the standard derived category of O_b-modules. Here TQ localizes strict tower complexes and rlim is the chosen total right derived strict inverse limit [def-pur-strict-quotient-completion-data]. The statement uses no Koszul presentation, quotient derived presentation, or descent comparison.

proof.text: Choose the exterior Koszul augmentations and diagonal/quotient transition maps from noetherian_koszul_augmentation_pro_zero, with eventual derived-zero cone transitions.

Use the proved exact coefficient realization, then apply the finite coefficient-cone comparison at U=O_b[0]. Map the eventual derived-zero transitions through this exact realization using localizedZero_map and conjugate by the strict comparison isomorphisms. This proves that the actual cone tower of alpha_U is pro-zero.

Use the strict tensor-cone comparison to identify the actual cone tower of alpha_P with tensorLeft P applied to the coefficient cone tower. K-flatness implies tensorLeft P preserves quasi-isomorphisms. localizedZero_map transports eventual derived-zero transitions and proZero_of_towerIso transports them across the strict isomorphism.

Apply the proved ringedLimit_proZero_isIso helper to the resulting FlatConstantConeProZero witness and to the chosen strictLimit universal right-derived pair. This proves invertibility for precisely rlim(O_b).map(TQ(O_b).map(alpha_P)), without changing any target or coefficient definition. The termwise-flat hypothesis is retained but the stronger generic K-flat transport makes it unnecessary to the proof.

proof_origin.place: Tag 099M, noetherian Koszul pro-isomorphism followed by exact constant realization, K-flat tensor and total derived inverse limit. R1 implements the localized-zero and right-derived-limit glue; two finite comparison steps are separately named.

theorem koszulQuotientAugmentation_isIso [IsNoetherianRing A] (b : Bool) (r : ℕ)
    (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = I)
    (α : ringedKoszulTensorTowerFunctor (coefficients J A I b) r
        (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap J A I b) (a i)) ⟶
      (reductionTower J A I b).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
    (hα : KoszulQuotientAugmentationLaws J A I b r a α)
    (P : Cx (coefficients J A I b)) (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
    (hflat : ∀ q : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlat (P.X q)) :
    IsIso ((rlim (coefficients J A I b)).map
      ((TQ (coefficients J A I b)).map (α.app P)))
